summary.value: Junior's Times Square is the cheesecake restaurant at 1515 Broadway at 45th Street in Times Square.

description.value: Junior's Times Square is the Midtown branch of the Brooklyn cheesecake landmark. It is at 1515 Broadway @ 45th Street, in the middle of the Theater District. Posted hours include Sunday – Monday 7am - 11pm, so it works for a late slice after a show. Restaurantji shows 4.3 1727 ratings. Representative Restaurantji praise (diner reviews): “Great service, great food, big meals and the cheesecakes!”. Representative watch-outs: “The weight was a little long but it is absolutely worth it”.
